name: 挺括有型三件套西服款

category.leaf: 男士三件套西装（含马甲）

description: 影棚深灰大片质感、三件套正装、合体版型与工艺细节讲透

styleLock.backgroundSystem: dark charcoal-grey studio gradient #4A4E55 for model screens and clean off-white #F5F6F7 seamless for info, grid and trust screens
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft large-softbox studio lighting, front-left key with gentle fill and a subtle shoulder rim, soft contact shadows grounding the figure, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte charcoal studio floor #3A3D42 and light matte board #EDEEF0 for flat lays
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headline type only, charcoal #2D2D2D text on off-white or deep navy #1F3A5F chips
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons and small numbered circle badges in a single navy accent #1F3A5F
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight three-quarter hero angle and consistent garment scale across the set, clean unexploded drape, faces cropped or turned away so the tailoring stays the subject
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium tailored suiting visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of dark charcoal-grey studio gradient #4A4E55, heather-grey suit tone #AEB6BF, clean off-white #F5F6F7 and one deep navy accent #1F3A5F with charcoal text #2D2D2D; neutral temperature with soft large-softbox lighting, front-left key with gentle fill, subtle shoulder rim and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headline type only; consistent rounded rectangular label chips and thin-line numbered circle badges; clean premium tailoring photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight three-quarter hero angle and consistent garment scale with clean drape; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 开场一秒建立挺括有型的整体印象，抢占搜索点击
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level with a slight three-quarter turn, full-length framing, complete three-piece outfit visible head to shoe
shots.lighting: bright soft large-softbox key from the front-left with gentle fill and a subtle shoulder rim, soft contact shadow at the feet
shots.textZone: top center clean text zone carrying one short headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #F5F6F7
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce hero photograph of {product} worn by a generic adult male model, full-length. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level camera with a slight three-quarter turn, the complete outfit visible head to shoe, jacket, waistcoat and trousers all readable, the figure filling 60-70% of the frame against the deep backdrop. Bright soft large-softbox key from the front-left with gentle fill and a subtle rim on the shoulders, soft contact shadow at the feet grounding the figure. Dark charcoal-grey studio gradient backdrop #4A4E55. Props: none. Top center of the frame keeps a clean zone carrying one short headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #F5F6F7, with the composition breathing evenly around the figure. Face turned away or cropped above the chin, generic model, garment drape kept clean. 4K commercial tailoring quality. Negative: no brand logo, no readable label or shop text, no watermark, no QR code, no recognizable face, no extra people, no distorted hands, no cut-off garment edges, no plastic-like sheen.

shots.intent: 用胸腰中景把版型挺括、肩线利落的核心利益一眼说清
shots.camera: eye-level camera with a slight three-quarter turn, waist-up mid-shot from chest to hip so lapel, shoulder line and waistcoat edge stay the subject
shots.lighting: soft even studio light from the front-left with gentle fill, soft controlled shadow
shots.textZone: right side clean negative space with one short headline 「{callout_1}」 in #2D2D2D and one thin-line icon in #1F3A5F
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}, cropped as a waist-up mid-shot. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Camera at eye level with a slight three-quarter turn, mid-shot from chest to hip so the lapel line, shoulder and waistcoat edge stay the subject, the garment filling 50-60% of the frame anchored to the left. Soft even studio light from the front-left with gentle fill, soft controlled shadow. Light grey seamless backdrop #E8E9EB. Props: none. The right side of the frame keeps clean negative space with one short headline 「{callout_1}」 in #2D2D2D and one thin-line icon in #1F3A5F. No visible face, garment drape kept clean. Negative: no dense body text, no more than one claim, no invented fabric composition or percentages, no brand logo, no watermark, no distorted buttons, no plastic-like sheen.

shots.intent: 放大买成衣容易肩塌腰松、扣位起褶的合身痛点，引出合体剪裁
shots.camera: straight-on camera, two matched panels with identical crop and framing, medium framing on headless tailor dummies
shots.lighting: left panel flat and slightly cooler for the problem state, right panel soft front-left key for the clean state, identical shadow direction
shots.background: light grey seamless #E8E9EB on both panels
shots.props: two headless tailor dummies only, no people
shots.textZone: one short label per panel 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #2D2D2D
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen with two matched panels, identical camera, crop and framing. Left panel: a plain off-the-rack suit jacket on a headless tailor dummy showing pulling folds at the button stance, a collapsed shoulder line and a loose waist. Right panel: {product} on a headless tailor dummy with a clean straight silhouette, smooth sleeve pitch and a neatly shaped waist. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on camera, medium framing on both panels with each dummy garment filling 50-60% of its panel, no faces anywhere. Light grey seamless backdrop #E8E9EB on both panels; the left panel lit flatter and cooler, the right panel lit soft with a front-left key and identical shadow direction. Headless tailor dummies only, no people. One short label per panel 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #2D2D2D with even margins around each label. Negative: no real model, no face, no fabricated statistics or test data, no exaggerated damage, no brand logo, no watermark, no extra text, no mismatched framing between panels.

shots.intent: 低角度行走场景强化挺拔气场，让买家代入正式场合
shots.camera: very low angle looking upward, full-length three-quarter walking view mid-stride
shots.lighting: soft natural-feeling studio daylight from the front-left, 5500K, gentle shoulder rim, soft floor shadow grounding the feet
shots.textZone: clean lower-third text zone carrying one short headline 「{callout_1}」 in #F5F6F7
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene photograph of {product} worn by a generic adult male model mid-stride, shot from a very low angle looking upward. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Full-length three-quarter walking view, one hand relaxed, complete outfit visible, the striding figure filling 50-60% of the frame with the low-angle composition breathing around him. Soft natural-feeling studio daylight from the front-left, 5500K, gentle rim light on the shoulders, soft floor shadow grounding the feet. Dark charcoal-grey studio gradient backdrop #4A4E55. Props: none. Clean lower-third text zone carrying one short headline 「{callout_1}」 in #F5F6F7. Face partially cropped or turned away, generic model. Negative: no recognizable face, no brand logo, no watermark, no QR code, no extra people, no distorted limbs, no floating feet without a contact shadow, no cluttered environment.

shots.intent: 微距呈现驳头花眼与走线做工，建立对品质的预期
shots.camera: tight 45-degree top-down macro angle on the lapel notch, shallow depth of field with the buttonhole edge sharp
shots.lighting: raking side light from the right revealing thread texture and the rolled lapel edge, controlled highlight with soft falloff
shots.whitespace: about 15% clean margin, the stitch detail is the whole point
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro photograph of the lapel buttonhole and hand-finished edge stitching of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Camera at a tight 45-degree top-down macro angle on the lapel notch, shallow depth of field with the buttonhole edge sharp. Raking side light from the right revealing thread texture, weave and the rolled lapel edge, controlled highlight with soft falloff. Neutral matte studio board background #3A3D42. Props: none. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame with about 15% clean margin around it. One small annotation label 「{callout_1}」 in #F5F6F7. 4K macro sharpness. Negative: no blurry subject, no invented craft or certification claims, no brand label or readable tag text, no watermark, no extra text, no plastic-like fabric sheen, no distorted stitching.

shots.intent: 用四格细节图把工艺一次讲透，支撑版型与做工认知
shots.camera: clean 2x2 grid, four equal square cells, each cell a tight close-up crop with matched framing
shots.lighting: matched soft front-left light on all four cells, identical white balance
shots.background: clean off-white #F5F6F7 with thin #1F3A5F separator lines and small numbered circle badges
shots.props: none beyond the four garment detail crops
shots.textZone: one short label per cell 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」 in #2D2D2D
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic detail grid for {product}: a clean 2x2 layout of four equal square cells, each cell a tight construction detail crop, the lapel buttonhole with pick stitching, the inner facing edge, the waistcoat button with dart, and the trouser hem with centre crease. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Each cell photographed as a tight close-up with matched soft front-left light and identical white balance. Clean off-white background #F5F6F7 with thin #1F3A5F separator lines and small numbered circle badges. Details fill 60-70% of the grid area with about 25% clean gaps and breathing space between cells. Each cell carries one short label 「{callout_1}」, 「{callout_2}」, 「{callout_3}」, 「{callout_4}」 in #2D2D2D. Negative: no invented fabric data or certifications, no readable brand label, no watermark, no dense body text, no mismatched lighting between cells, no distorted stitching.

shots.intent: 并排给出三件套与两件套两种组合，帮买家快速定款
shots.camera: eye-level camera at a consistent three-quarter angle, knee-up crop, two matched panels with identical framing
shots.lighting: soft even studio light from the front-left, identical on both panels
shots.background: light grey seamless #E8E9EB on both panels
shots.textZone: one short label below each panel 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #2D2D2D
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant grid of {product}, two matched panels side by side with identical camera, crop and lighting. Left panel: the full three-piece combination, jacket, waistcoat and trousers. Right panel: the two-piece combination, jacket and trousers only, worn by a different generic standing figure. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Eye-level camera at a consistent three-quarter angle, knee-up crop on both panels, identical framing and garment scale, each outfit filling 65-75% of its panel with a thin even gutter between the two panels. Soft even studio light from the front-left on both panels. Light grey seamless backdrop #E8E9EB on both panels. Props: none. One short label below each panel 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #2D2D2D. Faces turned away or cropped, generic figures. Negative: no lighting or color drift between panels, no recognizable face, no brand logo, no watermark, no extra text, no distorted hands, no mismatched garment scale.

shots.intent: 用平铺尺码信息图消除身高体重对不上码的疑虑
shots.camera: photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, jacket and trousers neatly folded flat side by side
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow
shots.productOccupancy: 50-60% (folded garment spanning the upper half, sleeves and trouser legs reaching toward the centre)
shots.whitespace: about 25% even panel margins across the layout
shots.textZone: thin dimension callout lines in #2D2D2D with two short labels 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」; a height-weight grid with generic axis labels 「身高」「体重」 and rows of short sample tokens; a three-column size table with generic headers 「尺码」「身高」「体重」 and short sample-token rows standing in for the real measurements
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce size spec infographic for {product}, photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle with the jacket and trousers neatly folded flat side by side. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow. Clean off-white background #F5F6F7. The folded garment fills 50-60% of the frame spanning the upper half. Layout: thin dimension callout lines in #2D2D2D with two short labels 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 pointing at the garment; below them a height-weight grid with generic axis labels 「身高」 and 「体重」 whose rows carry short sample tokens, and a three-column size table with generic headers 「尺码」「身高」「体重」 filled with short sample-token rows standing in for the real measurements to be swapped in later. About 25% even panel margins keep the layout breathing. Negative: no invented measurements, sizes or numbers, no dense body text, no unreadable tiny text, no brand logo, no watermark, no distorted straight lines.

shots.intent: 用退换承诺与轻松态度降低下单风险，稳住最后一层顾虑
shots.camera: straight-on camera, mid-shot, garment in a clean 90-degree side profile on a matte dark hanger so drape and silhouette read clearly
shots.lighting: even clean studio light with a soft contact shadow, garment edge separated from the light backdrop
shots.textZone: one large rounded card with a single large character 「{callout_1}」 in #1F3A5F, four small tag chips 「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」「{callout_5}」 in #2D2D2D
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce risk-reversal trust screen for {product}, shown in a clean 90-degree side profile on a matte dark hanger so the drape and silhouette read clearly. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on camera, mid-shot, even clean studio light with a soft contact shadow, garment edge separated from the light backdrop. Light off-white #F5F6F7 background. Layout: one large rounded card carrying a single large character 「{callout_1}」 in #1F3A5F, and four small tag chips 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」 「{callout_4}」 「{callout_5}」 in #2D2D2D stacked beside the card. The garment fills 60-70% of the frame with the card layout breathing evenly around it. Negative: do NOT invent return policies, guarantees, certifications, ratings or test data, no seals or stamps, no QR code, no store badge, no brand logo, no watermark, no dense body text, no floating garment without a contact shadow.

shots.intent: 整套同框配行动按钮收尾，把选择推到下单动作
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level camera with a slight three-quarter turn, medium group framing, the three pieces clearly separated and fully visible on a display form
shots.lighting: punchy soft studio key from the front-left with a subtle rim light from behind, soft contact shadow
shots.props: one matte grey display form only
shots.textZone: one short CTA 「{callout_1}」 in #F5F6F7 on a rounded #1F3A5F button below the display form
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce closing CTA shot of {product}: a knee-up group view of the complete set, jacket, waistcoat and trousers, arranged on a matte grey display form in a clean three-quarter composition. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level camera, medium group framing, the three pieces clearly separated and all fully visible with matched garment scale, the set filling 65-75% of the frame. Punchy soft studio key from the front-left with a subtle rim light from behind, soft contact shadow. Deep charcoal-grey backdrop #3A3D42. Props: one matte grey display form only. Text zone: one short CTA 「{callout_1}」 in #F5F6F7 on a rounded #1F3A5F button below the display form as the only text element. Negative: no invented discounts, prices or countdowns, no brand logo, no watermark, no QR code, no extra text, no cut-off garments, no mismatched scale between pieces.

provenance.notes: 从 8 张男装三件套西装详情页长图切片提炼；已剥离原品牌 LOGO 位与店铺会员二维码卡、模特面容与身份、原文案（含成分与产地表述）、原文案式排版的标题字与蓝色页眉装饰条；原文中的幽默退换图按其版式结构改写为信任收口屏的承诺卡片与标签芯片。面料成分、尺码数值、退换政策与所有数据一律以 {callout_n} 短标签承接由商家回填，产品一律以 {product} 占位。
